en.bdb: What a Sikh ought to do  ?

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਖਿ ਪਰਾਈਆ ਚੰਗੀਆ ਮਾਵਾਂ ਭੈਣਾਂ ਧੀਆਂ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: dhekh paraieeaa cha(n)geeaa maavaa(n) bhainaa(n) dheeaa(n) jaanai|

en.bdb: The Sikh ought to treat beautiful women of others as his mothers, sisters, and daughters.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਸੁ ਸੂਅਰੁ ਉਸੁ ਗਾਇ ਹੈ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੁਸਲਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: aus sooar us gai hai par dhan hi(n)dhoo musalamaanai|

en.bdb: Others' wealth for him is as beef for Hindu and pork for a Muslim.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਮੋਹੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਨ ਧੋਹਿ ਧਿਙਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: putr kalatr kuTa(n)b dhekh mohe moh na dhoh dhin(g)aanai|

en.bdb: Out of infatuation for his son, wife or family, he should not betray and deceive anyone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਆਪਹੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: ausatat ni(n)dhaa ka(n)n sun aapahu buraa na aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: While listening to the praises and slander of others, he should not talk ill of anybody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡ ਪਰਤਾਪੁ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਹੰਮੇਉ ਨ ਕਿਸੈ ਰਞਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: vadd parataap na aap gan kar aha(n)meau na kisai ran(j)aanai|

en.bdb: Neither he should count himself as great and glorious nor should he out of his ego, snub anybody.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੋਗੁ ਰਸ ਰਲੀਆ ਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukhafal paiaa raaj jog ras raleeaa maanai|

en.bdb: Gurmukh of such a nature practises Raj yoga (the highest yoga), lives peacefully a
And goes to sacrifice his self unto the holy congregation.
